name: 240p Test Suite
author: Artemio Urbina
description_short: Homebrew suite to evaluate capture cards, upscalers, line doublers and TV processing of 240p video signals.
description_long: Test patterns (PLUGE, color bars, grids, monoscope) and interactive tests (drop shadow, lag, scroll, striped sprites) for calibrating colors, geometry, overscan, and black/white levels. Includes MDFourier for audio signature analysis. The GameCube build also supports 480i, 288p, 576i and 480p evaluation modes.
